positive_snippets:
We stayed at the Atara for three nights. It's in a relatively peaceful location set back from the busy streets and there are some local malls, etc within walking distance

The staff were excellent, always helpful and friendly. The room was a little bit tired (damaged tiles, some marks on walls, etc) but it was spacious, clean,  the bed was comfortable, good shower and AC so overall we were happy.

Breakfast was good and it had some variety each day, the omelettes were a nice option

There is a lounge area where you can enjoy a coffee/beer etc which was good.

We would happily return

Hospitality at its best. A Very Good Boutique Hotel. Good Rooms, Exceptional Room Service and a Great Breakfast. The Boys in the hotel are very gentle and polite and is at your service any time. Breakfast are really good, you will get smoking hot dishes being served  Rooms are good enough with attached Balconies. Keep up the good work.

I stayed here for 15 days and can vouch that the hotel truly lived up to my expectations. It’s a cozy, comfortable boutique hotel in DLF Phase 1 with top-notch services. The staff is kind and helpful, and the food is amazing. Overall, it’s a great place to stay in Gurgaon, especially if you are traveling for work.
